name: claudemod
description: Claude Code mods: a pixel spark HUD, a task/sub-agent HUD, a follow-ups tracker, an RTL toggle and a session goal runner

plugins.name: clawd-hud
plugins.description: A pixel spark, usage batteries, a cache timer and a context meter

plugins.name: task-hud
plugins.description: A to-do progress bar above the prompt and a pane of pixel creatures, one per sub-agent

plugins.name: followups
plugins.description: Claude flags what it notices, asks whether to track it, and keeps a to-do you can export to memory, docs or the README

plugins.name: rtl-toggle
plugins.description: Fixes the reading order of chat lines that mix English and Hebrew (or other RTL) text

plugins.name: goal-run
plugins.description: Set a session goal, approve Claude's plan, and watch a pixel Claude in running shoes run it to 100%, with each task's token cost
